players.product: DDR5 / NAND burn-in testers (Samsung) and HBM4 wafer testers via subsidiary Digital Frontier (SK hynix)

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: Q2 2026 consolidated revenue KRW 168,631,873,359 (Q2 2025: KRW 119,269,899,032), up 41.4%, and Q2 operating profit KRW 39,589,999,867 (Q2 2025: KRW 12,249,705,307), up 223.2%; H1 2026 revenue KRW 274,333,155,139 (H1 2025: KRW 229,314,798,116), up 19.6%, and operating profit KRW 58,462,013,217 (H1 2025: KRW 22,174,897,566), up 163.6%. The company attributes revenue growth to customers expanding investment across memory including HBM on strong memory conditions, and profit growth to higher HBM test-equipment volumes and profitability

H1 2026 segment mix: semiconductor equipment revenue KRW 279,650,677 thousand with segment operating profit KRW 61,758,567 thousand (H1 2025: KRW 217,560,700 thousand and KRW 23,165,455 thousand); within it testers KRW 226,883M (82.7%) and burn-in boards KRW 35,424M (12.9%); electronic parts KRW 6,836,850 thousand, audio/video KRW 7,446,329 thousand, secondary-battery equipment KRW 1,701,280 thousand. Exports KRW 57,332M vs domestic KRW 217,001M. Burn-in board market share 40% (company estimate, 2026 H1; 38% in 2025). Average tester price KRW 698,534 thousand

Order backlog KRW 261,481M at June 30, 2026 (testers KRW 230,831M; burn-in boards KRW 30,651M), from total orders KRW 528,098M less deliveries KRW 266,617M. Inventory rose to KRW 138,055,839,569 from KRW 69,425,741,504 at end-2025, with semiconductor-equipment raw materials KRW 75,731,454,277 (end-2025: KRW 21,660,350,949)
H1 2026 production capacity: testers 220 units, produced 188, utilisation 85.5%; burn-in boards 6,000, produced 5,259, utilisation 87.7%

Subsidiary Digital Frontier (67.28% owned) began mass-production deliveries of the HBM4 wafer tester DF-5100 on 2026-02-24, after completing HBM4 wafer-tester quality evaluation and supplying from 2026; its DDR5 wafer tester DF-5200 has shipped since 2024.03 and was applied to HBM3/3E in 2025. Digital Frontier H1 2026 revenue KRW 156,393,952 thousand and net income KRW 36,081,908 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: Customer concentration in semiconductor equipment (customers not named in the note): consolidated Customer A KRW 170,608,541 thousand and Customer B KRW 65,135,828 thousand of H1 2026 revenue (H1 2025: KRW 144,229,958 thousand and KRW 49,344,797 thousand), against consolidated revenue KRW 274,333,155 thousand
quarterly_data.figure: Customer A KRW 170,608,541 thousand; Customer B KRW 65,135,828 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: Costs and investment: H1 raw-material purchases KRW 240,014M (ICs KRW 64,383M, chambers KRW 43,927M, PCB KRW 20,035M, sockets KRW 16,756M; suppliers not named); R&D KRW 6,269,947,048 (2.3% of revenue). Deconsolidated V10 System (secondary-battery vision inspection, now 43.75%) after selling shares for KRW 32 hundred million in June 2026; KRW 10,000M loan to Digital Frontier (2026-02-12). Of the KRW 30,000M 18th exchangeable bond, KRW 2,000M used so far with the rest earmarked for mid- to long-term R&D projects in 2026-2028
